records.topic: Abu Dhabi declaration and religious pluralism
records.title_en: Does divine providence permit religious diversity, or positively will contradictory religious doctrines?
records.title_fr: Dieu permet-il la diversité des religions, ou veut-il positivement des doctrines religieuses contradictoires?

evidence_tension.en: The 2019 joint declaration includes divine willing of religious pluralism. Distinguish the document's wording, later interpretative distinctions, coercion, and Catholic claims about the uniqueness of Christ; neither disguise the disputed clause nor infer that every religion is doctrinally equivalent.
evidence_tension.fr: La déclaration de 2019 évoque la diversité religieuse voulue par Dieu. Distinguer sa formulation, la volonté permissive et positive, le refus de la contrainte et l’unicité du Christ ; ne pas gommer la clause controversée ni conclure à l’équivalence des religions.

sources.scope: Dignitatis humanae §§1–2 on immunity from coercion

records.topic: Singapore statement and paths to God
records.title_en: Did Francis teach that every religion equally leads to God?
records.title_fr: François a-t-il enseigné que toutes les religions conduisent également à Dieu ?

evidence_tension.en: Quote the pope's 13 September 2024 interreligious remarks in context and separate his analogy of different paths from a formal definition of the salvific status of religions. Compare Catholic doctrine and the speech's non-definitive genre without silently rewriting the words.
evidence_tension.fr: Citer la déclaration interreligieuse du 13 septembre 2024 dans son contexte ; distinguer la métaphore des chemins d’une définition doctrinale du salut. Comparer la doctrine catholique et le genre non définitif de cette allocution.

sources.scope: Singapore youth speech, religions as paths

records.title_en: Are non-ritual blessings of couples compatible with the Church's doctrine on marriage and public scandal?
records.title_fr: Les bénédictions non rituelles de couples sont-elles compatibles avec la doctrine du mariage et l’exigence d’éviter le scandale ?

evidence_tension.en: Compare the 2023 declaration's explicit permission for blessings of couples with the 2021 refusal to bless same-sex unions and the 2024 explanatory notice. Distinguish blessing people, blessing a relationship, ecclesiastical approval, public symbolism and the different documents' stated scopes; retain strongest objections without treating mere terminology as dispositive.
evidence_tension.fr: Comparer la permission de 2023 concernant des couples, le refus de 2021 de bénir des unions et l’explication de janvier 2024. Distinguer personnes, relation, approbation ecclésiale et signe public ; présenter les objections sans les résoudre par un jeu de mots.

sources.scope: 2021 commentary on distinction between persons and unions

records.title_en: Does the sacramental discernment of Amoris laetitia maintain earlier teaching on indissolubility and Eucharistic discipline?
records.title_fr: Le discernement sacramentel d’Amoris laetitia préserve-t-il la doctrine antérieure du mariage indissoluble ?

evidence_tension.en: Place Amoris laetitia chapter VIII and its footnotes alongside Familiaris consortio 84, respecting differences between objective marital status, subjective culpability, conditions of admission to Communion, and authentic interpretive claims. Do not identify every pastoral case as the same.
evidence_tension.fr: Lire le chapitre VIII et ses notes avec Familiaris consortio 84 ; distinguer le statut objectif, la culpabilité subjective, les conditions de communion et les interprétations proposées. Ne pas assimiler toutes les situations.

records.title_en: Was Assisi 1986 shared prayer, parallel prayer, or a sign of religious indifferentism?
records.title_fr: Assise 1986 fut-elle une prière commune, des prières parallèles, ou un signe d’indifférentisme ?

evidence_tension.en: John Paul II expressly announced separate prayer settings and then successive religious prayers witnessed in common. Contrast the intended distinction with critiques of what the public gestures could signify, without claiming all faiths recited one shared liturgical formula.
evidence_tension.fr: Jean-Paul II annonça des lieux de prière séparés puis une succession de prières devant les participants. Confronter cette intention aux critiques du symbole public, sans prétendre qu’un rite commun unique fut célébré.

sources.scope: Speech specifying separate and successive prayer
Pope's final address clarifying diverse content

records.topic: Ecumenical common prayer and communicatio in sacris
records.title_en: When is ecumenical prayer permissible, and how does it differ from sacramental sharing or interreligious worship?
records.title_fr: Quand la prière œcuménique est-elle permise, et comment la distinguer du partage sacramentel ou interreligieux ?

evidence_tension.en: Use the 1993 Ecumenical Directory's permissions and distinctions, rather than a blanket ban or blanket permission. Separate common prayer among baptized Christians, interreligious events, and communicatio in sacris as distinct juridical-theological categories.
evidence_tension.fr: Partir des permissions et limites du Directoire œcuménique de 1993 plutôt que d’un interdit ou d’une autorisation absolus. Distinguer prière entre baptisés, rencontre interreligieuse et communicatio in sacris.

sources.scope: 1993 Ecumenical Directory, §§102–112 and sharing in sacramental life

records.title_en: How do Dignitatis humanae and earlier papal condemnations of religious indifferentism relate?
records.title_fr: Comment concilier Dignitatis humanae avec les condamnations antérieures de l’indifférentisme ?

evidence_tension.en: Dignitatis humanae explicitly distinguishes civil immunity from coercion from any moral claim that error is true. Compare it with preconciliar social kingship and doctrinal obligations, while acknowledging that the historical continuity/rupture debate has arguments on the precise extent of civil rights.
evidence_tension.fr: Dignitatis humanae distingue l’immunité civile de la contrainte de la valeur morale des croyances. La comparer à la royauté sociale du Christ en reconnaissant la controverse réelle sur l’étendue des droits civils.

sources.scope: §§1–2 on civil immunity and traditional duty

records.title_en: Is Catholic membership in Freemasonry still prohibited despite changes in canonical codification?
records.title_fr: L’appartenance à la franc-maçonnerie demeure-t-elle interdite malgré le changement du Code ?

evidence_tension.en: The doctrinal office's 1983 declaration explicitly retains the prohibition despite no express Masonic name in the 1983 code. A 2023 DDF reply restates it; distinguish this documentary conclusion from unsourced allegations about every lodge's secret conduct.
evidence_tension.fr: La déclaration doctrinale de 1983 maintient expressément l’interdiction malgré l’absence du mot dans le nouveau Code ; la réponse de 2023 le confirme. Ne pas la confondre avec des accusations non prouvées sur chaque loge.

records.title_en: Which forms of communism and socialism were condemned, and what claims are distinct from Catholic social obligations?
records.title_fr: Quelles formes de communisme et de socialisme sont condamnées, et quelles obligations sociales faut-il distinguer ?

evidence_tension.en: Divini redemptoris identifies atheistic materialist communism and its account of person and society as targets of condemnation. Do not convert this into an unqualified condemnation of every policy of social aid or equate distinct economic programs without their actual premises.
evidence_tension.fr: Divini redemptoris vise le communisme matérialiste athée et son anthropologie. Ne pas confondre cette condamnation avec toute politique de solidarité ou tous les programmes économiques distincts.

sources.scope: Public obligations and the common good

records.title_en: What evolutionary hypotheses may Catholics examine without denying the immediate creation of the soul?
records.title_fr: Quelles hypothèses évolutionnistes un catholique peut-il examiner sans nier la création immédiate de l’âme ?

evidence_tension.en: Humani generis §36 explicitly allows investigation into the origin of the human body from pre-existing living matter while insisting the rational soul is directly created by God. Scientific hypotheses and revealed claims must not be collapsed into either scientism or biblical literalism.
evidence_tension.fr: Humani generis §36 permet la recherche sur l’origine biologique du corps humain tout en affirmant la création immédiate de l’âme rationnelle. Ne confondre ni hypothèse scientifique ni affirmation révélée.

records.topic: Adam and Eve, polygenism and original sin
records.title_en: How does polygenism relate to the historical fall and transmission of original sin?
records.title_fr: Comment le polygénisme se rapporte-t-il à la chute historique et à la transmission du péché originel ?

evidence_tension.en: Humani generis §37 says the faithful cannot simply embrace the stated polygenist thesis because its reconciliation with original sin is not apparent. This precise historical doctrinal statement should not be distorted into either an empirical genetic finding or a declaration that the biological mechanism has been solved.
evidence_tension.fr: Humani generis §37 met en garde contre la thèse polygéniste parce que sa compatibilité avec le péché originel n’apparaît pas. Ce jugement doctrinal n’est ni une preuve génétique ni une explication biologique complète.

records.title_en: When may a state lawfully use military force, and who judges necessity and proportionality?
records.title_fr: Quand l’État peut-il employer la force armée, et qui juge nécessité et proportionnalité ?

evidence_tension.en: Catechism 2309 sets cumulative conditions for legitimate military defense and assigns their application to prudential judgment by political authorities. A just cause does not remove noncombatant protection or make every particular military plan morally permissible.
evidence_tension.fr: Le Catéchisme 2309 exige des conditions cumulatives de défense et confie leur application à la prudence des autorités publiques. La cause juste n’efface pas la protection des civils ni ne justifie toute méthode.

records.title_en: How do the absolute ban on indiscriminate attacks and contingent claims about nuclear deterrence differ?
records.title_fr: Comment distinguer l’interdiction absolue d’attaques indiscriminées et les jugements contingents sur la dissuasion nucléaire ?

evidence_tension.en: Gaudium et spes §80 explicitly condemns indiscriminate destruction of cities; §81 discusses arms accumulation as deterrence. Keep the moral norm, strategic probability and any current political judgment analytically separate.
evidence_tension.fr: Gaudium et spes §80 condamne la destruction indiscriminée des villes ; §81 traite de la dissuasion par accumulation d’armes. Distinguer norme morale, stratégie et prudence politique.

records.title_en: Does Catholic teaching require one political regime, or principles such as the common good and Christ's social kingship?
records.title_fr: La doctrine catholique exige-t-elle un régime politique unique, ou des principes de bien commun et de royauté sociale du Christ ?

evidence_tension.en: Quas primas affirms Christ's social kingship and the public duties of society; Dignitatis humanae speaks to civil religious freedom. Neither short citation is a self-standing proof that every monarchy is obligatory or every democracy inherently illegitimate; evaluate constitutions and public duties separately.
evidence_tension.fr: Quas primas affirme la royauté sociale du Christ ; Dignitatis humanae aborde la liberté religieuse civile. Aucune citation isolée ne rend obligatoire toute monarchie ni illégitime toute démocratie.

sources.scope: Pius XI on public reign of Christ

records.title_en: Does artificial intelligence possess personhood or intrinsic moral worth, and how does transhumanism assess human dignity?
records.title_fr: L’intelligence artificielle possède-t-elle une personnalité morale, et comment le transhumanisme évalue-t-il la dignité humaine ?

evidence_tension.en: Antiqua et nova distinguishes artificial computational capacity from embodied human intelligence and dignity; it rejects reducing persons to performance. Do not infer scientific consciousness findings from theological anthropology, or equate each assistive technology with transhumanist metaphysics.
evidence_tension.fr: Antiqua et nova distingue la capacité de calcul de l’intelligence humaine incarnée et de sa dignité. Ne pas déduire un état scientifique de conscience de l’anthropologie théologique ni assimiler toute aide technique au transhumanisme.

records.topic: Ecology, Laudato Si and political responses
records.title_en: Which duties of stewardship are doctrinal, and which climate remedies demand empirical or political judgment?
records.title_fr: Quels devoirs de sauvegarde de la création relèvent de la doctrine et quelles réponses climatiques de l’expertise politique ?

evidence_tension.en: Laudate Deum addresses climate harm and scientific evidence, while creation stewardship is a moral concern. Do not turn a specific climate forecast or preferred regulation into a defined dogma; nor treat every empirical uncertainty as a license to neglect duties toward others.
evidence_tension.fr: Laudate Deum évoque les dommages climatiques et les données scientifiques, tandis que la sauvegarde de la création relève aussi de la morale. Ne convertir ni prévision ni politique particulière en dogme, ni l’incertitude en dispense de responsabilité.

sources.scope: Laudate Deum on climate and responses

records.topic: Conspiracy allegations and standards of evidence
records.title_en: What evidence distinguishes legitimate criticism of institutions from calumny and unfounded conspiracy allegations?
records.title_fr: Quelles preuves distinguent la critique légitime de la calomnie et des accusations complotistes infondées ?

evidence_tension.en: Catechism 2477 forbids rash judgment, detraction and calumny. Historical institutional failures remain legitimate investigative questions, but allegations about secret coordinations need named actors, documents, dates and alternative explanations, not numerical coincidences or unsourced ethnic imputations.
evidence_tension.fr: Le Catéchisme 2477 condamne jugement téméraire, médisance et calomnie. Les fautes institutionnelles peuvent être étudiées, mais les accusations de coordination secrète exigent acteurs, documents, dates et examen d’autres explications.

sources.scope: Source criticism in exegesis, method comparison only

records.title_en: Does synodality revise papal or episcopal governing competence, or alter the consultation process?
records.title_fr: La synodalité modifie-t-elle la compétence du pape et des évêques, ou la consultation ecclésiale ?

evidence_tension.en: The 2018 International Theological Commission text treats synodality within hierarchical communion; the 2023 dubia and Francis' replies identify real concerns over decision authority. Distinguish consultation, episcopal collegiality, governing decisions and dogmatic claims rather than reducing the dispute to slogans.
evidence_tension.fr: Le texte de 2018 situe la synodalité dans la communion hiérarchique ; les dubia de 2023 interrogent l’autorité de décision. Distinguer consultation, collégialité, gouvernement et dogme.

records.title_en: What distinction holds between SSPX sacramental faculties, institutional canonical status, and individual consciences?
records.title_fr: Quelle différence entre les facultés sacramentelles de la FSSPX, son statut canonique institutionnel et les consciences personnelles ?

evidence_tension.en: Benedict XVI's 2009 documents distinguish remission of episcopal excommunications from SSPX institutional status and legitimate ministry. Later particular pastoral faculties must be examined separately; neither claiming total reconciliation nor denying every individual faculty follows from the 2009 statement.
evidence_tension.fr: Benoît XVI distingue en 2009 la levée des excommunications du statut institutionnel et de la légitimité du ministère. Les facultés particulières postérieures doivent être examinées à part ; aucune conclusion simpliste n’est correcte.

sources.scope: Papal letter, distinctions of persons and institute

records.topic: Canonisation and evaluation of recent pontificates
records.title_en: Does a canonization certify all a saint's prudential decisions or resolve doctrinal disputes about a pontificate?
records.title_fr: Une canonisation approuve-t-elle toutes les décisions prudentielles d’un saint ou tranche-t-elle les controverses de son pontificat ?

evidence_tension.en: The 2014 canonization of John XXIII and John Paul II is a real act of the Church. Do not silently equate recognition of sanctity with an itemized endorsement of every private judgment, governance choice or contested historical event; questions about infallibility of canonizations require their own theological authorities.
evidence_tension.fr: Les canonisations de 2014 sont des actes ecclésiaux réels. Ne pas les assimiler à l’approbation de chaque décision, conduite de gouvernement ou jugement historique ; l’infaillibilité des canonisations appelle des autorités théologiques spécifiques.

sources.scope: Vatican I limits of defined papal infallibility, not a direct canonization treatise

records.title_en: What exactly did Pius X condemn under Modernism, and which contemporary phenomena require independent proof?
records.title_fr: Qu’a exactement condamné saint Pie X sous le modernisme, et quels faits actuels nécessitent une preuve distincte ?

evidence_tension.en: Pascendi sets out named epistemological and theological errors; it cannot be replaced with the imprecise label 'anything modern'. An accusation that a modern writer holds those theses needs the writer's exact text, doctrinal category and chronology rather than attribution by association.
evidence_tension.fr: Pascendi décrit des erreurs philosophiques et théologiques précises ; le mot « moderne » n’est pas une preuve de modernisme. Toute accusation contemporaine exige un texte exact, une qualification doctrinale et sa chronologie.
